meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

copy.tagline: 把通道连接到智能体分组,管理隔离级别,新增通道分组
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要管理多个智能体分组,并需要控制它们之间的通道和隔离。
copy.tagline_en: Connect channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, and add channel groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple agent groups and need to control channel wiring and isolation.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能查看渠道与智能体组的接线状况,并帮你选择隔离程度把聊天渠道接上去:同一对话、同一智能体的独立对话,或单独的智能体;还能把已有接线挪到另一组。
howto.when: 在添加完新的渠道、还在初始设置中,或想单独重新配置接线时触发(用户提出管理渠道的需求)。

say.text: 帮我看看现在哪些渠道连着哪些智能体组。
say.note: 会读取配置并显示接线情况和权限用户。

say.text: 把刚加的 Telegram 群接给写作智能体,用“同一智能体不同对话”模式。
say.note: 会问平台 ID 并按所选隔离选项注册接线。

say.text: 把 Slack 的 #sales 渠道从销售组换到支持组。
say.note: 会删除旧接线并新建,历史会话仍留在原组。

howto.what_en: Claude can inspect channel-agent wiring, help attach a channel with chosen isolation (same conversation, same agent separate threads, or new agent), and move wirings to another group.
howto.when_en: Used after adding a channel, during setup, or when the user asks to reconfigure existing channel wiring.

say_en.text: Show me which channels are wired to which agent groups.
Wire the new Telegram group to the writing agent with separate sessions.
say_en.note: Asks for platform ID and registers wiring per isolation.

say_en.text: Move the #sales Slack channel from the sales group to support.
say_en.note: Removes old wiring, creates new one; old sessions stay.
